# AGENTS.md

Guidance for coding agents working in `@dsomega-boostrap/projen` (the package
name spelling is intentional).

A **jsii/projen library**, not an application: it publishes reusable projen
project types (`PythonPixiMonorepo`, `RepoAnalyzerPython`, `ViteProject`) that
other repos instantiate in their `.projenrc.ts`. TypeScript compiles via
**jsii** to `lib/`; most configuration is generated by **projen** 0.99. Tests
use **Jest 27** + `ts-jest`; lint/format is **Biome 2** only (no ESLint, no
Prettier); package manager is **Yarn 1**. Source of truth: `.projenrc.ts` +
`src/`.

## Architecture: `_projects` vs `_lib`

- **`src/_projects/`** — complete, user-facing **project templates**. Each
  directory is one project type exported for downstream `.projenrc.ts` files.
- **`src/_lib/`** — **generic, reusable components and helpers**. These are
  internal and are not exported from the package entrypoint.
- A `_projects` template is **constructed from `_lib` components and projen
  library components** (`TextFile`, `TomlFile`, `IniFile`, `SampleDir`,
  `Component`, and other projen primitives). Put project-agnostic generation
  logic in `_lib`; keep project-specific wiring in `_projects`.
- Every project template file uses the **`_project.ts` postfix**:
  `src/_projects/<Name>/<Name>_project.ts`, re-exported by the directory's
  `index.ts` and then by `src/_projects/index.ts`.

## Commands

```bash
yarn install                 # install dependencies
npx projen                   # synth: regenerate managed files from .projenrc.ts
npx projen compile           # jsii compile src/ -> lib/ (authoritative typecheck)
npx projen build             # synth, compile, docgen, test, package
npx projen test              # jest --passWithNoTests --updateSnapshot, then biome --write
npx projen test:watch        # jest --watch
npx jest                     # jest only, coverage enabled
npx jest --coverage=false    # faster local run
npx projen biome             # biome check --no-errors-on-unmatched --write
npx biome check              # lint/format check only, no writes (CI-style)
npx projen docgen            # regenerate docs/API.md from the jsii manifest
npx projen compat            # jsii-diff API compatibility check
npx projen upgrade           # upgrade deps and re-synth; never hand-edit deps
npx projen release           # CI release flow; do not run locally unless asked
```

### Running one test

```bash
npx jest src/_lib/Python/python.utils.test.ts --coverage=false
npx jest src/_lib/Python/python.utils.test.ts -t "parses >= dependencies" --coverage=false
npx jest src/_lib/Pixi --coverage=false
```

Jest `testMatch`: `src/**/*.test.ts`, `src/**/__tests__/**`, `test/**/*.test.ts`.
`npx projen test` also runs Biome with `--write` and updates snapshots, so
review unexpected rewrites after running it.

## Repository layout

```text
.projenrc.ts                  # projen config; edit here, then `npx projen`
src/index.ts                  # public entrypoint: exports only `./_projects`
src/_projects/<Name>/         # full project templates (one type per directory)
  <Name>_project.ts           # full template; required `_project` postfix
  index.ts                    # barrel re-export
src/_projects/index.ts        # barrel for every project type
src/_lib/<Domain>/            # generic reusable components/helpers (internal)
  <domain>.utils.ts           # pure helpers
  <domain>.types.ts           # internal-only types
  <domain>.utils.test.ts      # colocated unit tests
test/                         # project-level/integration tests
docs/API.md                   # generated API docs (canonical)
API.md                        # legacy generated copy; do not hand-edit
lib/ dist/ coverage/ test-reports/ .jsii   # build artifacts, never edit
```

## Generated files: do not edit by hand

`package.json`, `tsconfig.json`, `tsconfig.dev.json`, `biome.jsonc`,
`.projen/*`, `.github/workflows/*`, `.gitignore`, `.gitattributes`,
`.devcontainer.json`, `.gitpod.yml`, `.mergify.yml`, `.npmignore`, `LICENSE`,
and `docs/API.md` are generated. Change them via `.projenrc.ts` (or `src/` for
docs), run `npx projen`, and commit the output. CI fails if `npx projen build`
produces an uncommitted mutation. `lib/`, `dist/`, `coverage/`,
`test-reports/`, `.jsii`, and `lib/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo` are artifacts: never
edit or commit them. `API.md` at the root is a legacy generated copy.

## Code style

### Formatting and imports

- Biome is authoritative: **tabs**, **double quotes**, semicolons, trailing
  commas, 80-column wrapping. Run `npx projen biome` before finishing; edit
  `biome.jsonc` only through `.projenrc.ts`.
- Let Biome sort imports; use `import type { ... }` for type-only imports.
  Node builtins use `node:` (`import fs from "node:fs";`).
- `fp-ts` deep imports keep `.js` (`fp-ts/lib/Array.js`,
  `fp-ts/lib/function.js`); relative imports inside `src/` omit extensions.
  Import projen internals from their subpath (`projen/lib/javascript`,
  `projen/lib/typescript`) when not root-exported.
- Prefer named imports; default only for CJS packages that need it (`dedent`).

### Types and naming

- `strict` plus `noUnusedLocals`, `noUnusedParameters`, `noImplicitReturns`,
  `strictNullChecks`, `strictPropertyInitialization`: handle every return path
  and remove dead imports/params.
- Public option/struct types are **interfaces** named `<Project>Options` or
  `<Thing>Props`; fields are `readonly`, optional fields use `?`, and TSDoc
  `@default` documents fallbacks.
- `PascalCase` for classes/interfaces/type aliases; `camelCase` for functions,
  locals, properties, and module-global constants (existing `pythonGitignore`
  is the precedent). The `I` prefix exists only on internal helpers such as
  `IPythonDependency`, never on public API structs.

### API design and jsii constraints

- `src/index.ts` exports `_projects` only. `_lib` stays internal; re-export a
  required type from its project file (see the `export type { ... }` block in
  `PythonPixiMonorepo_project.ts`).
- jsii supports classes, interfaces (structs), and enums. Do not export free
  functions, type aliases, or unions from the public entrypoint.
- Every exported class, interface, method, and property needs TSDoc; use
  `@default`, `@param`, and `@returns` where useful.
- Public structs: interfaces with `readonly` fields; no optional methods,
  overloads, or union-typed public properties.
- After public API changes, run `npx projen compile` — jsii, not plain `tsc`,
  validates the API.

### Error handling and implementation

- Fail fast with `throw new Error("...")` including the offending value and
  expected format (see `parseInstallRequiresDependency`). Do not swallow
  errors; the only `console.error` is the non-fatal `mkdir` in `.projenrc.ts`.
  Prefer early returns and `??` / `?.`; return `undefined` from
  `synthesizeContent` when no file should be emitted.
- Avoid `any`, non-null assertions, and casts. If unavoidable, suppress
  narrowly with a reason: `// biome-ignore lint/suspicious/noExplicitAny: <reason>`.
- Model generated files with projen primitives (`TextFile`, `TomlFile`,
  `IniFile`, `SampleDir`, `SampleFile`, `Component`) instead of writing to
  disk; direct `fs` use is limited to the `.projenrc.ts` bootstrap.
- Reusable file logic is a `Component` subclass (`PixiPackage`,
  `ViteComponent`), not code in the project constructor body. Project classes
  extend `cdk.JsiiProject` or `typescript.TypeScriptProject` and forward
  `...options` to `super`.
- Use `fp-ts` (`pipe`, `flow`, `A.map`, `R.upsertAt`) as the existing code
  does; plain loops are fine in simple cases.

## Testing conventions

- Colocate unit tests beside internals as `<name>.test.ts`; put broader tests
  in `test/`. Use `describe`, `test`, and `test.each` with
  `expect(...).toEqual(...)`, asserting structurally rather than on huge file
  bodies. Coverage goes to `coverage/`, JUnit XML to `test-reports/`; neither
  is committed.

## Commits and pull requests

- Commits follow `configs/cz/personal.js`: `[Type](Scope): Past-tense subject.`
  with types `Enh`, `Fix`, `Docs`, `Style`, `Refactor`, `Perf`, `Test`,
  `Build`, `Chore`, `Revert`, `Wip`, `Sync` (scope optional).
- PR titles are validated by `amannn/action-semantic-pull-request` and must
  start with `feat`, `fix`, or `chore`.
- Before a PR: `npx projen build` passes and leaves no generated-file diff;
  include regenerated `docs/API.md` when public API changes. Do not push,
  release, or run `npx projen clobber` / `release` unless asked.

## Pre-finish checklist

1. `npx jest <changed tests> --coverage=false` passes.
2. `npx projen biome` (or `npx biome check`) is clean.
3. `npx projen compile` succeeds for public API changes.
4. `npx projen` ran if `.projenrc.ts` changed, and generated diffs are understood.
5. No edits to `lib/`, `dist/`, `coverage/`, `.jsii`, or generated config.
